title: Dashboard stuck on skeleton loaders — JavaScript initialization blocked by alert() during auth check

reproduction.description: Opening http://localhost:8100/index.html in a clean browser session (no v5d_session cookie) shows only skeleton loaders. No sidebar labels, no stats, no projects, no activity. The page appears frozen.

root_cause.primary: alert() call in auth:expired event handler blocks JavaScript execution thread during initial page load
root_cause.secondary: getWorkspaceId() swallows AUTH_EXPIRED errors, converting them to generic WORKSPACE_ERROR, preventing the dashboard from showing a clear login prompt
chain_of_events: 1. Page loads, JS files parse correctly
4. api.js request() handler emits 'auth:expired' event + throws AUTH_EXPIRED
5. auth:expired handler calls alert('Your session has expired...') — BLOCKS UI THREAD
6. checkSession() catch block sets authenticated=false, fires _notify()
8. After user dismisses alert, logout() fires → navigate('dashboard') → renderDashboard()
9. renderDashboard() replaces content with new skeletons
10. _loadProjects/_loadStats fail with 401 → auth:expired fires AGAIN → alert() AGAIN → infinite loop
11. Meanwhile, API calls in getWorkspaceId() throw AUTH_EXPIRED which is swallowed → WORKSPACE_ERROR
12. _loadProjects catch shows 'Could not load projects' instead of 'Sign in required'
13. Skeletons persist because alert() blocks the async replacement code

corrections.before: alert('Your session has expired. Please sign in again.');

corrections.change: Added _initialSessionCheck flag to suppress auth:expired during initial load
corrections.detail: Prevents redirect loop when checkSession() gets 401 on first visit

corrections.change: Added isAuthenticated() guard to auth:expired handler
corrections.detail: Prevents redirect loop from unauthenticated API calls in renderDashboard()

corrections.change: Propagate AUTH_EXPIRED errors in getWorkspaceId() instead of swallowing them
corrections.detail: Allows _loadProjects() to show 'Session expired' prompt instead of generic error

corrections.change: Added fallback to use first workspace from list if default_workspace_id is not set

corrections.detail: If API calls haven't completed within 10s, skeletons are replaced with error state + Retry button

tests_added: Verified all 9 JS files parse correctly (node --check)
Verified CORS headers allow localhost:8100 with credentials
Verified API returns correct 401 for unauthenticated requests
Verified dashboard JS boots without syntax errors

browser_retest.dashboard_stats: EXPECTED: 4 stat cards from API (59 projects, 21 active, etc.)
browser_retest.skeleton_removal: EXPECTED: Skeletons replaced within 2s of page load
browser_retest.navigation: EXPECTED: Sidebar links navigate between pages
browser_retest.error_state: EXPECTED: API failure shows error message + Retry button
browser_retest.note: Requires user to click 'Sign In' on first visit for live data
